summary: Monday's session showed a clear defensive rotation: tech and growth names lagged badly (QQQ -6.3% vs XLP +4.3% over two weeks) while elevated volatility (VIX 19.9, well above its 16.6 average) pushed capital into long-duration Treasuries (TLT +2.1%) and gold held flat against a falling SPY. Crypto stayed the weak spot, with BTC down 11% over 30 days and momentum still negative.
tweet: Growth sold off, staples and bonds caught the bid, and crypto kept bleeding as volatility stayed elevated into Monday's close.
